notes.note: The copyright footer has no fields: mod_footer draws two language strings. MOD_FOOTER_LINE1 carries the site name and the year, so it follows the site name override; MOD_FOOTER_LINE2 (the Joomla licence notice) is hidden by a language override with an empty value (the kit's hiddenBy). Both are overrides of the mapping file (#584).

No recipe for a search results page: no demo page shows a search box (checked on the running 1.0.11 home page: no search form), and the only route to the results page is the template showcase menu item (/pages/j-pages/smart-search), which the blank site removes with every demo menu item. A build that adds a search box later needs a recipe then.
